_about: The sights. clickMoa is what one click of elevation moves the strike, windageClickMoa one click of windage, in minutes of angle; clicks is the travel each way from the middle. zoom is the magnification range; fovFtAt100 the field of view in feet at 100 yards at the lowest and highest zoom.

ar-irons.name: AR-15 iron sights (front post, rear aperture)

source.note: front post elevation on a 16-inch carbine: 1.25 MOA per click on a 20-inch rifle (https://www.ssusa.org/content/everything-you-wanted-to-know-about-ar-15-service-rifle-iron-sights/), more on the carbine's shorter sight radius; compiled tables give 1.875 (https://smith-wessonforum.com/threads/s-w-m-p-15-iron-sight-adjustment-question.615786) and 1.5 to 2.0 (FM 3-22.9 figures at 25 m, https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/policy/army/fm/3-22-9/c05.htm); 1.75 is the middle of the band. read from the search engine's indexed text of this page on the date given: this session's network allowed web search but no page fetches

rear windage on a carbine: 0.5 MOA per click on the rifle, 0.62 to 0.75 on the carbine across the same sources; 0.75 used. read from the search engine's indexed text of this page on the date given: this session's network allowed web search but no page fetches

clicks.estimate: the front post has about 12 clicks of useful travel each way from a mid setting; the rear drum far more. Not a maker figure

frontPostMoa.estimate: the A2 front post is 0.07 in wide seen over a sight radius of about 14.75 in on a 16-inch carbine: 0.07 / 14.75 radians = 16 MOA. Dimensions are the common ones, not a BCM figure

apertureMoa.estimate: the large (0.2 in) aperture seen at about 2.5 in from the eye covers about 2 degrees; drawn as the dark ring around the view

low.estimate: the eye's view through the rear aperture spans about 2 degrees of the world past the ring: drawn as about 400 ft at 100 yards

high.estimate: same: the same basis as the figure next to it in this entry

utg-2-7x44.name: UTG AccuShot 2-7x44 30 mm long eye relief scope (SCP3-274LAOIEW)

source.note: retailer listing of the maker's specification (no leapers.com page surfaced in search): 1/4 MOA per click, zero-locking target turrets, 30 mm tube, illuminated mil-dot reticle, eye relief 9.5 to 11 in. Chosen as the likeliest UTG scope reaching 7x for a Vepr: UTG's other 2-7x (SCP-27PRGW) is sold as a handgun scope with 13.8 to 25 in of eye relief, and UTG makes no 1-7x; a long-eye-relief scope is what fits a side-rail or cover mount on an AK-pattern rifle. read from the search engine's indexed text of this page on the date given: this session's network allowed web search but no page fetches
